# Live Logistics Control Tower

<div class="subtitle">
نحن نوفر معلومات فورية لمسارات الشحن وتوقعات دقيقة لمواعيد الوصول في عمليات النقل البري والموانئ داخل العراق
</div>

<div id="map" class="map-container"></div>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.3/dist/leaflet.css" />
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.3/dist/leaflet.js"></script>

<script>

// ===================================================
// 1. Determine WebSocket endpoint
// ===================================================
let wsURL;

// Detect environment
if (location.hostname === "localhost" || location.hostname === "127.0.0.1") {
    wsURL = "ws://localhost:8000/ws";
} else {
    // For deployment (update to your ngrok or server)
    wsURL = "wss://logistics-backend.fly.dev/ws";
}

console.log("Using WebSocket:", wsURL);

const ws = new WebSocket(wsURL);

// ===================================================
// 2. Setup Leaflet Map
// ===================================================
const map = L.map('map').setView([33.3, 44.4], 6);

L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
  maxZoom: 18
}).addTo(map);

// Marker storage
const truckMarkers = {};
const shipMarkers = {};
let routeLine = null;
let routeLine4 = null;

// Icons
const truckIcon = L.icon({
    iconUrl: 'https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/741/741407.png',
    iconSize: [32, 32]
});

const shipIcon = L.icon({
    iconUrl: 'https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/5362/5362721.png',
    iconSize: [32, 32]
});

// ===================================================
// 3. Handle incoming WebSocket messages
// ===================================================
ws.onmessage = (event) => {
  const data = JSON.parse(event.data);

  // ---------------- ROUTE LINES -----------------
  if (routeLine) {
      map.removeLayer(routeLine);
  }
  routeLine = L.polyline(data.routePolyline, {color: 'blue'}).addTo(map);

  // Recenter
  if (data.routePolyline && data.routePolyline.length > 0) {
      const bounds = L.latLngBounds(data.routePolyline);
      map.fitBounds(bounds);
  }

  // ---------------- TRUCKS -----------------
  Object.values(data.trucks).forEach(t => {
    if (!truckMarkers[t.id]) {
        truckMarkers[t.id] = L.marker([t.lat, t.lon], {icon: truckIcon})
           .bindPopup(`${t.id}<br>Status: ${t.status}<br>ETA: ${t.eta}`)
           .addTo(map);
    } else {
        truckMarkers[t.id]
          .setLatLng([t.lat, t.lon])
          .setPopupContent(`${t.id}<br>Status: ${t.status}<br>ETA: ${t.eta}`);
    }
  });

  // ---------------- SHIPS -----------------
  Object.values(data.ships).forEach(s => {
    if (!shipMarkers[s.id]) {
        shipMarkers[s.id] = L.marker([s.lat, s.lon], {icon: shipIcon})
          .bindPopup(`${s.id}<br>Status: ${s.status}`)
          .addTo(map);
    } else {
        shipMarkers[s.id]
          .setLatLng([s.lat, s.lon])
          .setPopupContent(`${s.id}<br>Status: ${s.status}`);
    }
  });
};


// ===================================================
// 4. Error Handling
// ===================================================
ws.onerror = (err) => {
    alert("WebSocket connection failed. Is the server running?");
    console.error(err);
};

</script>
